units.source_text: 只此两句，着墨不多，笔致断断续续。

en.t: Only these two lines were written, with little ink spent and a broken, halting touch.

units.source_text: 王命妇大喜，便把这答诗送给源氏公子。

en.t: Lady Wang was overjoyed and at once sent this reply poem to Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 源氏公子以为是照例没有回音的，正在忧愁纳闷。

en.t: Prince Genji had thought there would be no answer as usual, and was just then grieving in puzzled sorrow.

units.source_text: 一见回信，喜出望外，兴奋之余，不觉流下泪来。

en.t: When he saw the reply, his joy exceeded all expectation, and in his excitement tears came to his eyes before he knew it.
